continuity: The Skeleton King has borrowed Jin Taekyung’s appearance through absorption and is heading toward Morgoth; he intends to sacrifice himself in that form, believing the monsters’ promise to stop their destruction and slaughter if Jin is surrendered is false.

The Skeleton King can hear and sense the dead spirits, whom he considers his people; he suspects he may once have been human, but remembers nothing and sometimes experiences déjà vu since traveling with a strange fellow.
Morgoth was summoned from beyond distant stars and space by Asmodeus, but does not know why; he says he is not devoted to Asmodeus and does not intend to die for him.
Morgoth welcomes a hero to his palace; the chapter does not explicitly identify the arriving guest.
plot: The Skeleton King, wearing Jin Taekyung’s appearance through a newly discovered ability to absorb, travels through a land of death toward Morgoth. He listens to the dead spirits and regards them as his people, then crosses into a pitch-black region, intending to sacrifice himself in Jin’s form. He believes humanity will learn that surrendering Jin will not stop the monsters’ destruction and slaughter.

Morgoth recalls his lifelong curiosity, his first entry into the Demon Realm, and his unanswered questions about why Asmodeus summoned him and prepared the current situation. He sets those questions aside to welcome a hero who has arrived at his palace.
translation_decisions: Keep the Skeleton King distinct from Jin Taekyung: the Skeleton King has borrowed Jin’s appearance; Jin is not established as physically present in this scene.
Render 魔力 as “magical power,” distinct from mana, and render 九泉 as “Nine Springs.”

active_continuity: Morgoth’s three-day deadline is still running; his demand for Cheon Taemin and Jin Taekyung as tribute remains in effect.
Cheon Taemin remains unconscious in a recovery capsule in a hidden Pentagon chamber.
Jin believes Cheon Taemin was the Martial God and The Helper, and suspects Asmodeus was not completely erased; these identities and suspicions are unconfirmed.
Jin ordered World Hunter Federation forces to mobilize for Moscow against Morgoth and his monsters, but intended to go alone.
